item.description:
0.14September 2026

  • AddedCove says when Claude Code or Codex is out of date, and updates it
  • ImprovedChats stream, scroll, and switch tabs faster
  • ImprovedModel menus list each account's own lineup, best models first
  • ImprovedSource Control is one list, with Repository and Changes sections
  • ImprovedThe transcript view mode is app-wide, with a row in Settings ▸ Assistant
  • ImprovedThinking mode gives every tool run its own row
  • Added⌥-clicks in a markdown file open the path it names, at the line it cites
  • AddedChat tab and title menus can delete the chat
  • ImprovedCode blocks and tool output scroll sideways unless Wrap Lines is on
  • ImprovedChats streaming in a covered or minimized window stop stealing frames
  • ImprovedPictures a tool returned draw in one strip under the run
  • ImprovedGrayed account rows say why they can't be picked
  • ImprovedSettings says when the default account can't send
  • ImprovedFile links read paths holding a space, a +, or an @
  • ImprovedFolded tool runs lead with what they did to files
  • ImprovedCard headers wear one circled glyph, at one size
  • FixedScheduled wake-ups resume a chat later, and survive a restart
  • FixedGit, formatters, and language servers resolve the way a login shell does
  • FixedStaging and branch actions say when git is missing
  • FixedCodex sign-in ends in Cove, not in the ChatGPT app
  • FixedFailed sign-ins keep their row, with the reason and a Try Again
  • FixedAccounts stop offering Sign In after a sign-in that worked
  • FixedAdding an account no longer takes the default
  • FixedQuestion and plan cards no longer stand as empty boxes
  • FixedReopened chats no longer leave blank gaps where a run's images were
  • FixedVertical scrolls over a code block move the chat again
  • FixedCode fences under a list item draw as code while they stream
  • FixedTool cards take Wrap Lines, and keep it across a tab switch
  • FixedCard verbs leave the composer's attachments and highlight alone
  • FixedQueued follow-ups send the images they were written with
  • FixedAnswering a card takes the chat's unread mark down
  • FixedResume no longer offers itself beside a live turn
  • FixedParked cards answer as the account just picked
  • FixedComposer text follows a light↔dark switch
  • FixedGroup boxes stop drawing an end cap mid-run
  • FixedTool card titles stop truncating with room to spare
  • FixedRenamed chats stop leaving their title spark mid-name
  • FixedRestored terminals keep their name
  • FixedCleared terminals come back cleared after a restart
  • Fixed⌃L leaves nothing drawn above the cleared page
  • FixedHovers renew the terminal's scrollbar rather than summoning one
  • FixedSkill folders in Tasks remember their fold
  • FixedBranch rows stop clipping the last digit of their commit count
  • FixedDiffs draw a deleted trailing blank line
  • FixedPane dividers and panel seams draw whole in both appearances
  • FixedThe pointer stops going stale under another app's menu
  • FixedFiles copied in Finder paste as files, not as their name
  • Fixed⌘V in a composer with no attachment strip pastes the text
  • FixedIdentifiers that merely contain a TLD stop linking
  • FixedThe image preview's zoom readout stops shifting the bar beside it

0.13September 2026

  • AddedRepository (⇧⌘Y), a window for branches, commits, and diffs
  • AddedPlan cards reject, revise, or accept into a permission mode
  • ImprovedSource Control is the working copy, with history in Repository
  • AddedCommit options for amend, sign-off, bypass hooks, and Commit and Push
  • AddedAn operation banner for a rebase, merge, or cherry-pick under way
  • AddedMessages from other sessions arrive as their own chat rows
  • ImprovedCodex chats catch up to Claude's on restarts, skills, commands, and usage
  • AddedAssistant settings say when each account's usage limit resets
  • AddedThe assistant files task cards for work it passed over
  • ImprovedChats scroll smoother and stream without stalling
  • ImprovedQuick Open and the composer's @ menu rank instantly on large trees
  • ImprovedWindows restore and files open faster
  • AddedMarkdown files open rendered or in the editor by preference
  • AddedAsk Assistant quotes selections in previews, rendered pages, and diffs
  • Added⌘- and ⇧-clicks open a chat link in another pane
  • AddedHeld clicks on a title toggle open that mode in another pane
  • ImprovedFinished task runs say so in their row
  • ImprovedThe Tasks sidebar groups global and plugin skills apart
  • AddedMarkdown previews keep code blocks unwrapped across relaunches
  • ImprovedQuitting keeps terminal shells alive for a quick relaunch
  • ImprovedThe assistant's worktree setting is saved per workspace
  • ImprovedA failed turn is a record in the transcript, not a reply
  • ImprovedPermission cards read clearer, and keep Allow primary when unfocused
  • ImprovedChat titles name a session after its first exchange
  • ImprovedThe provider menu grades every account it lists
  • Improved⌘-clicking an address opens it without raising the browser
  • ImprovedHover popovers fold types nested past two levels
  • ImprovedThe usage popover's Spent section folds, and names fresh input
  • ImprovedTables and blocks under a list item draw at its indent
  • ImprovedCode fences in a chat offer one menu, however they are drawn
  • ImprovedDiff hunk bands and expander glyphs center on the numbers
  • ImprovedCommit message fields each type onto their own undo stack
  • ImprovedPrompt suggestions wait until the chat is back at the reader
  • ImprovedImage previews open at a round zoom stop
  • ImprovedSidebar headings line up with the file tree's columns
  • ImprovedSearch result headings drop a directory rather than clip it
  • ImprovedThe background tasks popover is as wide as its longest line
  • AddedAddresses in an error card are links
  • AddedRaw <img> tags in a reply draw as pictures
  • FixedBookmarked chats are no longer pruned with old workspaces
  • Fixed⌘W closes whichever window is in front, the updater's included
  • FixedStopping a turn no longer leaves a mark nothing clears
  • FixedUsage gauges read the chat's own account, not the window's
  • FixedChats restore at the place they were left
  • FixedChat prose selections clear, and no longer paint over bullets
  • FixedChat inline-code pills fit the line they sit on
  • FixedA resumed turn ends when it ends, not 30 seconds later
  • FixedThe Dock badge stops counting a chat that went back to work
  • FixedChat list sections stay put as ages tick over
  • FixedDeletions above the first line redraw whole
  • FixedQuick Open's list follows the arrow keys again
  • FixedSymlinks appear in Quick Open
  • FixedThe pointer stops flickering over chats and while a menu is up
  • FixedThe account usage popover survives a focus change
  • FixedSidebar and license labels follow a light↔dark switch

0.12September 2026

  • AddedCodex as a second Assistant provider (after Claude)
  • AddedWeb previews tint the pane with the page's color
  • AddedForce click defines a word in a chat or composer
  • ImprovedSettings splits General into Editor and Terminal
  • ImprovedAssistant account rows carry every verb in a ··· menu
  • AddedAssistant account renaming
  • FixedSwitching branches no longer flashes phantom changes
  • FixedPlain JavaScript projects no longer show an LSP error
  • AddedLint-disable directives link rules to their docs
  • AddedThe usage popover breaks a chat's spend down by kind of token
  • ImprovedQuick Open ranks names that start with the query first
  • Added⇧-click extends a chat's selection from the last press
  • AddedMarkdown Preview reopens scrolled where it was left
  • ImprovedThe background tasks popover has a running count and a Stop All
  • ImprovedThe composer's / menu leads with recently used commands
  • ImprovedQuick Action's > is drawn as a chevron
  • ImprovedNew tasks start with Show in Terminal unchecked
  • ImprovedMarkdown headings and lists are set at clearer sizes
  • ImprovedChat prose uses the current theme's colors
  • ImprovedStopping a turn keeps the chat's process warm
  • ImprovedSession stops the agent refuses say so in the chat
  • ImprovedUpdate notes carry an Added / Fixed / Improved pill per line
  • FixedDrops on a web preview reach the pane behind it
  • FixedA file-system watch the system refuses no longer crashes Cove
  • FixedNon-terminal Tasks load .zshrc
  • FixedChats working in the background no longer mark themselves unread
  • FixedSending from up the transcript follows the reply down again
  • FixedThe pointer no longer flickers at a transcript link's edge
  • FixedPane titles cut a long name at the tail, not under the toggle
  • FixedTurn usage is credited to the org the turn launched under
  • FixedUsage meters don't read stale while a limit is in force
  • Fixed⌫ at Quick Action's chevron returns to file search
